name: Aditya Consumer Marketing Limited
about: Aditya Consumer Marketing Limited, operates and manages supermarkets, salon and spa, and restaurants in India. It operates through Retail Trade; Food & Beverage; and Salon segments. The company operates retail under the 9to9 Super Market brand; restaurants under the Yo! China, Take-Away-Express, 9to9 Biryani & Street Food, and Banquet & Conference Hall brand names; and salon and spa for women and men under the 9to9 Salon brand. Aditya Consumer Marketing Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Patna, India.
